h1: Branäs ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Branäs rises above the Klarälven valley in Värmland with 32 lifts, 36 slopes and 415 metres of vertical - more drop than Sälen. It is the nearest large Swedish resort to both Oslo and Gothenburg, and the mountain carries a Fun Park, a Funslope and a Nintendo Land for children.
stayOverview: Branäs is one village at the foot of the slopes, with Sysslebeck down in the Klarälven valley as the cheaper alternative.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The mountain is compact enough that ski-in ski-out is the normal case rather than a premium.
rentalCars: Most guests drive: Branäs is roughly three hours from Oslo and four from Gothenburg, and there is no railway to the village.
